title: Billing Review Standard: Repeated Off-Peak Rate Error Courtesy, Residential Electricity Supply
content:
Billing review standard, Residential Electricity Supply. A courtesy is added to an off-peak dispute when the same rate error recurs on the agreement.

**Rule.** The agreement's off-peak energy lines billed at the full contract rate are counted; with three or more such lines the high systemic error courtesy of 5.00 USD is added, with exactly two the mid systemic error courtesy of 3.00 USD is added, and with only one nothing is added.

**What is counted.** Off-peak energy lines on the agreement, whenever billed, whose rate on the line equals the contract rate recorded on the agreement.

| Off-peak lines billed at the full contract rate | Systemic error courtesy |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 5.00 USD |
| exactly 2 | 3.00 USD |
| only 1 | nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** A Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 agreement whose off-peak lines for March, April and May were each billed at the contract rate adds 5.00 USD; had only April been billed that way, nothing would be added.
